subject: Loading multiple files into R on a Mac

messages.author: 9098726f670e847b
messages.subject: Loading multiple files into R on a Mac
parts:
Hello,
I'm right now working through chapter 4 of QCLWR on my Mac and sometimes have problems with loading and saving files as described in the code. 
Just now I was trying to load the two files "corp_bnc_sgml_2.txt" and "corp_bnc_sgml_4.txt" into R in order to create a frequency list of them. I hope that I didn't misunderstand the task!

 I first tried doing this with the following (due to the 2nd grey box on p. 114): 

> corpus.files<-file.choose() # I understand that this is the Mac function for choose.files()

Unfortunately this only allows to select one file (as I also found confirmed in this previous post: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/corpling-with-r/load$20several$20files/corpling-with-r/7iVCm34lAbM/7-8uz6SekQIJ) 

Then I looked at the all code file and it contained a select.list function for Mac/Linux users, which I copied and pasted. Here is the output:

 > corpus.files<-select.list(dir(scan(nmax=1, what="char")), multiple=T)
1: /Users/violawiegand/_qclwr/_inputfiles/corp_bnc_sgml_2.txt
Read 1 item

:  

Enter one or more numbers separated by spaces, or an empty line to cancel
1: 
> corpus.files
character(0)


I had expected a dialogue to pop up, similarly to file.choose() so that I could choose the two files. This was not the case and instead I tried entering one of the file names upon the "1:" prompt. However, this didn't seem to work, as corpus.files doesn't seem to contain the contents of corp_bnc_sgml_2.txt. How should I react to this prompt properly? Or is there any other way that I could choose multiple files on a Mac?

Thank you!

Best,
Viola
